description: One session id with two transcript files in one project (review 2026-09-28, finding 1): a transcript is never a fork of itself. X: two identical files, one listed. Y: the second file adds a turn; that file is listed and the turn survives. Z: each file has a turn of its own; both are listed, the smaller from its first own turn, each with its own stripped file. errors[] names each case; nothing goes to fork_collapsed.
